title: Fixed instruction gates
statement: Let $\kappa$ be finite, let $m,w,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $F:\kappa\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})$, let $z$ be a Boolean list, and choose $\kappa_0\in\kappa$.
